text: Appeal of a Property Standards Order (November 10, 2022) for 805 College Street, Exterior.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 10, 2022) for 805 College Street, Exterior, Folder Number: 22 226926 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2023.
